test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The manager noticed / that Pragya / was first to reach / the office on Saturday.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase "**was first to reach**." 
 
• A more grammatically correct way to express this would be "**was the first to reach**."
 
• The inclusion of the definite article "**the**" is necessary for clarity and correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager noticed that Pragya** was the first to reach** the office on Saturday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "the office on Saturday."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "that Pragya"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "The manager noticed"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
